listings.title: African Development Bank Agri-Food SME Catalytic Financing Mechanism
listings.description: Concessional financing and grant-based technical assistance supporting agricultural SMEs through eligible financial intermediaries and agribusinesses; the cited transaction includes cocoa value-chain and equipment financing support.
listings.eligibility: Eligibility depends on the specific intermediary or investee and AfDB non-sovereign requirements.
listings.seo_title: Agri-Food SME Catalytic Financing Mechanism - Côte d’Ivoire
listings.seo_description: Official AfDB agricultural SME finance and technical assistance information.

listings.title: AgDevCo / IFAD Blended Finance Initiative
listings.description: Blended financing initiative for early-stage agricultural enterprises, initially focused on Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania and Uganda.
listings.eligibility: Early-stage agricultural enterprises in the stated countries; final investment eligibility is determined by AgDevCo.
listings.seo_description: Official IFAD information on blended financing for early-stage African agribusinesses.

listings.title: AfDB-GAFSP Agro-Inputs Risk Sharing Facility
listings.description: Risk-sharing and technical-assistance facility designed to improve access to credit for agro-input suppliers and agricultural SMEs in five countries.
listings.eligibility: Targeted at agro-input suppliers and eligible agricultural SMEs through participating financial institutions; verify current access arrangements before applying.
listings.seo_description: Official AfDB information on agricultural input finance in Ethiopia, Uganda, Tanzania, Malawi and Zambia.

listings.title: Nigeria Sustainable Agricultural Value-Chains for Growth (AGROW)
listings.description: World Bank-supported Nigeria project including a results-based matching grant facility for qualifying agribusinesses and investment in agricultural value chains.
listings.eligibility: Targeted agribusinesses and agricultural value-chain participants under the project rules; application arrangements should be confirmed through official project channels.
listings.seo_description: Official World Bank information on Nigeria AGROW and its agricultural matching-grant facility.

listings.title: CREW Project Agricultural Machinery Procurement
listings.description: AfDB-financed climate-resilient wheat value-chain project procurement for supply and installation of agricultural machinery and related equipment.
listings.seo_description: Official AfDB procurement notice for agricultural machinery and related equipment under Ethiopia's CREW Project.

listings.title: ZAVaCLEP Agro-Processing Machinery Procurement
listings.description: AfDB-financed Zimbabwe Agricultural Value Chain and Livelihoods Enhancement Project procurement for agro-processing machinery and training.
listings.seo_description: Official AfDB procurement notice for agro-processing machinery and training in Zimbabwe.

listings.title: Southern Africa Mechanization Hire Service Hubs
listings.description: FAO Hand-in-Hand Southern Africa investment concept for mechanization service hubs providing tractors and small-scale implements, with financing and technical support components.
listings.lease_terms: Mechanization hire-service model; terms depend on the implementing investment and service hub.
listings.seo_title: Southern Africa Mechanization Hire Service Hubs
listings.seo_description: FAO 2026 investment concept for machinery hire service hubs in Southern Africa.

listings.title: Sierra Leone Cassava Processing Equipment Procurement
listings.description: African Development Bank procurement notice for supply and delivery of cassava processing equipment for an agricultural project in Sierra Leone.
listings.seo_title: Sierra Leone Cassava Processing Equipment Procurement
listings.seo_description: Official AfDB procurement notice covering cassava processing equipment in Sierra Leone.

listings.title: Eritrea Solar-Powered Irrigation System Procurement
listings.description: African Development Bank procurement notice for supply, installation and commissioning of solar-powered irrigation systems at five sites under DRSLP V.
listings.seo_description: Official AfDB procurement notice for solar-powered irrigation systems in Eritrea.

listings.title: Mali Motor Pump Procurement for Irrigated Farms
listings.description: African Development Bank procurement notice for acquisition of 10 motor pumps for village irrigated perimeters in northern Mali under PIDACC/BN.
listings.seo_title: Mali Motor Pump Procurement for Irrigation
listings.seo_description: Official AfDB procurement notice for irrigation motor pumps in Mali.

listings.title: Rwanda Farmers' Organizations Financing Programme
listings.description: IFAD, Bank of Kigali and Aceli Africa financing initiative combining a US$12 million IFAD package with US$9 million co-financing to expand finance for farmers' organizations and smallholder farmers.
listings.eligibility: Farmers' organizations and eligible agricultural value-chain borrowers in Rwanda; financing is delivered through the participating financial institution and programme arrangements.
listings.seo_description: Official IFAD information on agricultural financing for farmers' organizations in Rwanda.

listings.title: Burkina Faso ORIAM-SA Climate-Resilient Agriculture Financing
listings.description: IFAD financing agreement for the Strengthening Agricultural and Rural Infrastructure for Food Sovereignty Project, supporting climate-resilient agriculture, sustainable infrastructure and agricultural value chains.
listings.eligibility: Project participation and financing follow the ORIAM-SA implementation arrangements agreed by IFAD and the Government of Burkina Faso.
listings.seo_description: Official IFAD information on climate-resilient agriculture financing in Burkina Faso.

listings.title: Nigeria AgriConnect Agricultural Finance and Investment Framework
listings.description: Nigeria AgriConnect Compact backed by government and development partners to strengthen access to affordable credit, insurance and blended finance across priority agricultural value chains.
listings.eligibility: Access will depend on the financing instruments, programmes and participating institutions established under the Nigeria AgriConnect Compact.
listings.seo_description: Official IFAD information on Nigeria AgriConnect and expanded agricultural finance and investment.

listings.title: Djibouti AgriConnect
listings.description: National AgriConnect framework focused on livestock, horticulture and date-palm value chains, with investment in agricultural services, rural finance and infrastructure and expanded access to credit.
listings.eligibility: Access depends on the financing instruments, programmes and participating institutions established under the Djibouti AgriConnect Compact.
listings.seo_description: Official IFAD information on Djibouti AgriConnect and rural agricultural finance.

listings.title: Africa Rural Climate Adaptation Finance Mechanism (ARCAFIM)
listings.description: US$200 million, 12-year blended-finance mechanism led by IFAD and Equity Group to expand climate-adaptation lending to smallholder producers and rural MSMEs across East Africa.
listings.eligibility: Smallholder producers, agricultural value-chain businesses and rural MSMEs accessing participating financial institutions and programme channels in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Rwanda.
listings.finance_amount: US$200 million mechanism; US$180 million lending capital plus approximately US$20 million technical assistance
listings.seo_title: ARCAFIM East Africa Climate Agricultural Finance
listings.seo_description: Official IFAD ARCAFIM blended finance mechanism for farmers and rural businesses in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Rwanda.
